newsitem.title: USA: US Trade Representative creates new Japan office.
newsitem.headline: US Trade Representative creates new Japan office.

text.p: U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky on Thursday announced the creation of a separate Japan office and named Wendy Cutler to head it.

"The volume, importance and sensitivity of Japan trade issues warrants the full time attention of an office dedicated exclusively to Japan trade issues so I am pleased to establish such an office for the first time at USTR," Barshefsky said.

Cutler, who has been with USTR for nine years, will be named as the first assistant U.S. trade representative for Japan. From 1993-1996 she served as deputy assistant U.S. Trade Representative for Japan.
Byron Sigel was named to replace departing Jim Southwick as deputy U.S. trade representative, Barshefsky said.
